basis: The mapped roof outline places the hall. The Imperial Household Agency booklet gives the hall and roof plan dimensions. The preservation association gives the full height. The Agency conservation tender identifies the 18-step stair. Two cleared Qualla photographs show the shallow lower skirts, steep upper roof, veranda, columns and stair.
estimated: The exact veranda and lower eave elevations, lower-to-upper roof breaks, timber profiles, rails and bracket spacing were matched visually. Natural ground is from the frozen terrain field and the finished grade datum is an approximation.
